newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistan stocks close higher on synthetics.
newsitem.headline: Pakistan stocks close higher on synthetics.

text.p: Pakistani stocks jumped towards the close on Wednesday as prices of synthetic stocks jumped on expectations that polyester staple fibre (PSF) rates will soon be raised by the manufacturers, dealers said.

"The rise in the synthetic sector, specially Dewan Salman Fibres, pushed the index up on expectations that manufacturers will adjust the PSF prices after the devaluation of the rupee," dealer Sajjad Mankani said. The Karachi 100-share index rose 10.93 points, or 0.76 percent, to end at 1,444.99. Losers led gainers 121 to 118. Dewan Salman Fibre rose 1.30 rupees to 29.80 and Union Bank 0.90 to 10.15. -- Amir Zia 9221-5685192
